verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a basic workflow for manual artifacts. You can upload documents or policies and bulk-assign owners (vanta-docs-23), make a user accountable for a control (vanta-docs-30), and attach an evidence file to a document and submit it for review (vanta-docs-31). The rest of the lifecycle the story asks for has no evidence on the document side; the only reminder evidence concerns risk assessments (vanta-docs-22), not manual evidence. Missing for 10: due dates on manual evidence, renewal reminders, expiry/staleness tracking for uploaded artifacts, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
